lines: ME MESSING AROUND IN THE SHOWER
ALWAYS HAVING GREAT FUN ON IMGFLIP
WANTS TO GIVE EVERYONE A UPVOTE. ME
WANTS TO GIVE EVERYONE A UPVOTE. THE FACT THAT NOT EVERY MEME I SEE IS FUNNY. ME
WATCHING BOB ROSS ON YOUTUBE AT 4 AM
AWESOME MEME I THOUGHT WOULD EASILY MAKE FRONT PAGE WITH ONLY 5 UPVOTES AFTER 24 HOUR
LAME MEME I MADE JUST TO USE UP MY SUBS ON THE FRONT PAGE IN 12 HOURS
GETTING HOMEWORK DONE, CHORES DONE, DOING ANYTHING PRODUCTIVE
ME TRYING TO GO TO BED ON TIME

meaning.meaning_en: The meme depicts a character happily reaching for a large, desirable object, only to be blocked by a larger, indifferent entity that prevents them from getting it. It expresses the frustration of having your goals or fun ruined by an external force or a more dominant person who stands in your way. The text boxes are used to label the character, the object they want, and the obstacle blocking them.
meaning.meaning_de: Der Meme zeigt eine Figur, die sich glücklich nach einem großen, erstrebenswerten Objekt streckt, nur um von einer größeren, gleichgültigen Entität daran gehindert zu werden. Er drückt die Frustration aus, dass deine Ziele oder dein Spaß durch eine externe Kraft oder eine dominantere Person vereitelt werden. Die Textfelder werden verwendet, um die Figur, das Objekt, das sie will, und das Hindernis zu beschriften, das sie blockiert.
